record.question: ………… was sworn in as Italy's youngest ever Prime Minister on February 2014
record.explanation: Answer C: Mr. Mateo Renzi. Matteo Renzi and his government took the oath on 22 February 2014. The Italian Presidency's original ceremony announcement identifies him as Prime Minister. Printed Mateo Renzi is an unmistakable spelling error in option C. Historical/source note: Source misspells Matteo as Mateo. Renzi was 39 at appointment; historical February 2014 event. Reference: https://presidenti.quirinale.it/Elementi/209295; https://www.esteri.it/it/sala_stampa/archivionotizie/interventi/2014/03/20140307_dellavedova_sioi/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
